parsedRooms.name: Standard Double Room
parsedRooms.description: Air-conditioned rooms here will provide you with a cable TV. Featuring a shower, private bathrooms also come with free toiletries.

parsedRooms.name: Deluxe Single Room
parsedRooms.description: Guests will have a special experience as this single room features a fireplace. Offering free toiletries, this single room includes a private bathroom with a shower and slippers. The air-conditioned single room offers a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a private entrance, soundproof walls, a tea and coffee maker as well as city views. The unit offers 1 bed.

parsedRooms.name: Classic Triple Room
parsedRooms.description: The fireplace is a top feature of this triple room. Featuring free toiletries, this triple room includes a private bathroom with a shower and slippers. The air-conditioned triple room features a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a private entrance, soundproof walls, a tea and coffee maker as well as city views. The unit has 2 beds.
